1.consolidated_definition: Persona o empresa que emplea trabajadores. Anglicismo adaptado, frecuente. Un joven ambicioso que pudo convencer a un empleador para que lo contratara a cambio de trabajar una semana de gratis, Blake ha dado un salto sobre los cursos a nivel de principiantes y va camino a obtener su diploma de equivalencia (El Pueblo Latino, 26-06-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Person or company that employs workers. Adapted Anglicism, frequent. A young ambitious individual who was able to convince an employer to hire him in exchange for working a week for free, Blake has taken a leap over beginner-level courses and is on his way to obtaining his equivalency diploma (El Pueblo Latino, 26-06-08)
